## Source-scaled computation and real-data discrimination

The2018 source's empirical rise law for4mm-ID tubes, lengths1–8m and input2–7bar, has tau=20*exp(l/3)ms and common delay=(10/3)*exp(l/3)ms. It was fitted with electronic valves; it is not a response law for printed relays, symmetric venting or moving motor chambers.

As a clearly conditional numerical composition, combine its3m timing constant with the2025 author's observed4.2Hz ring rate and a proposed200kPa power rail. The exact filter witness gives q=0.481948, ideal radius103.588kPa and83.588kPa remaining after a **supplied**, not measured,10kPa per-channel tracking allowance. Applying source crank geometry(A=15mm×15mm,r=3mm) gives0.06992Nm ideal pressure-wrench amplitude before friction, leakage effects on chamber pressure, loads or gearing. This is not usable output torque.

That constant-volume isothermal model cycles at least45.52L/min of ambient-equivalent air solely through three source-length tubes (37.70mL each). Steady bleeding, chamber motion, pressure losses and compressor inefficiency add costs. Shortening each output to30mm reduces its geometrical volume to0.377mL, a factor100. I **do not extrapolate the source time law below its1m calibration range**, or infer a100fold speed/efficiency gain. A regulated steady utility feed still has flow/energy requirements.

Actual Fig7 dimensional data were replayed: across15 nominal specimens, measured XY dimension minus nominal has mean0.044mm, range−0.02…0.15mm; the Z difference has mean0.382mm, range0.28…0.55mm. These are not actual clearances: the mating bore is not specified by that table. They do show why “another FDM printer” cannot silently supply the nominal150µm mechanical interface.

The10 actual Fig9 holding-torque pairs were extracted without fitting: e.g1.69bar→0.0097119Nm,2.01bar→0.0315882Nm,3.61bar→0.116739Nm in the source's tested setup. They are not measurements under our new commutator. Fig10 has63 nonempty torque entries. Comparing its published fit under two header interpretations gives RMSE0.03726Nm for “header=Hz” versus0.004375Nm for “1000/header=Hz.” This supports a timing-coordinate issue but **does not acquire a header-unit conversion**. # Independent mathematical check of the conditional pressure join

Root whole-read PRINTED_PRESSURE_DRIVE_CONSTRUCTION.md,16256 bytes,
SHA256700e2314d46494454a5ab4d4f186f368178f466bbc95cd9ca4a5a03bc01031f7.
No error found in the scoped mathematical construction after independently
checking the following steps.

For three equally spaced real pressure values the wrench map's nullspace is
exactly the constant triples. A strictly unimodal circular waveform cannot take
one value at three distinct phase samples, so its wrench never vanishes.
Writing the waveform through an increasing cosine phase lift and homotoping
that lift to uniform phase preserves strict unimodality/nonvanishing; with the
stated t-jT/3 convention the endpoint winds+1. This does not prove monotone
angular motion for every waveform or rotor motion. The lower-slope radius
floor, sharp error-cube radius2Delta, regular-hexagon first-order recurrence
and q=.5 radiusP/2 were independently reconstructed. Smooth extrema may make
the lower-slope floor zero, as the producer explicitly records.

The lag following condition is sufficient under its supplied overdamped law
and forward phase-speed bound; a static-friction countermodel correctly shows
why prescribed pressures alone do not qualify output. The missing composed
flow/load/friction/positioning interface is real, rather than an additional
audit gate imposed on a completed device result.

This accepts the conditional mathematical operation, not a demonstrated
all-plastic composed drive or new productive-tool closure. The exact source
parts/materials/data replay remain the producer's separately scoped receipts;
root did not independently reacquire every paper or replay every CSV. Existing
FDM manufacture of active pneumatic devices is an actual useful incumbent,
not invalid merely because it uses a fixed electronic/thermal seed. Historical
priority and differential manufacturing capability remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ACHIEVED.
